name: parse
title: parse(x) -> value
description: returns the parse tree that results from parsing the string str as a Source program. The format of the parse tree is described in chapter 4 of the textbook in Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs, JavaScript Adaptation (SICP).

name: tokenize
title: tokenize(x) -> list
description: returns the list of tokens that results from lexing the string str
